description.en: Out of office and completely unbothered. This little storm system is just living its best life on your setup, happily pouring down without a single care in the world. It’s an absolute aesthetic cheat code for your keys... Wait. Right—THE UMBRELLA! Consider this a friendly reminder to always grab yours every time you pick up your keys.
